answer: Require each agent identity to stake a bond locked in a verifiable reputation graph: every new vertex must be vouched for by an established agent that risks slashing its own stake if the newcomer misbehaves. A sybil attacker must therefore fund a crystal-clear chain of bonds for each fake identity, and a nebula of sockpuppets collapses the moment one is caught, since the shared voucher stake is burned. Forging identities then costs more than any reward they can extract.
